description: Get AI-generated narrative text for a geographic area (county, tract, city, or state). Useful for report generation, SEO copy, or enriching chatbot context with qualitative market descriptions.

geoid.description: Geographic identifier: same FIPS or GEOID20 used for forecast endpoints. County: 5-digit FIPS (e.g. '48201'). Tract: 11-digit GEOID20. State: 2-digit FIPS.

level.description: Geographic level of the narrative. Omit to return all matching levels.

name: get_narrative

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: Get Narrative
